skill.name: Routine
skill.description: Create daily routine notes with unchecked tasks from yesterday.

skill:
Execute this skill when the user asks to create today's routine note, daily note, or carry forward unchecked tasks from yesterday.
- One tool call per turn. Wait for each tool result before proceeding. - Use the runtime-injected `Yesterday:` and `Today:` paths exactly — do not search, list, or guess filenames. - Never modify yesterday's note. - Never claim success before `write_file` returns a success payload in the conversation history.
- Routine notes live at `routine/[Month]/[Month] [Day] - [Weekday].md`. - The Obsidian system prompt injects resolved paths, e.g. `Yesterday: routine/July/July 15 - Wed.md` and `Today: routine/July/July 16 - Thu.md`.
- From yesterday's note, extract only unchecked task lines matching `- [ ] ...`. - Ignore checked tasks (`- [x]`), headings, events, notes, and placeholder text. - If yesterday's note is missing or has no unchecked tasks, proceed with an empty carry-forward list.
## Summary
## Events
## Notes
### Step 1: Read yesterday's note - `read_file(relativePath: )`
### Step 2: Read or create today's note - `read_file(relativePath: )`
If today's note does not exist: - `write_file(relativePath: , operation: create_new, content: , summary: "Created today's routine note")`
If `create_new` returns a notice that the file already exists: - Treat the file as existing and continue with append logic in Step 3.
If today's note already exists: - Do not call `create_new`. Keep the existing content unchanged unless Step 3 requires an append.
### Step 3: Carry forward unchecked tasks - Build the list of unchecked tasks extracted in Step 1. - Drop any task whose text (after `- [ ]`) already appears in today's note. - If the filtered list is empty, stop — no further writes are needed. - Otherwise append the remaining task lines immediately under the `## Summary` heading using: - `write_file(relativePath: , operation: append, content: , summary: "Moved unchecked tasks from yesterday into today's routine")` - Preserve task wording exactly. One task per line.
### Step 4: Finish - Return a brief user-facing summary of what was created or updated, including the today path.
